items.item_text: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience)
4-6 years Expertise and working knowledge in Oracle PL-SQL, Oracle DBA, ASP.net, Visual Basic, C#, C++, Crystal Reports, MS Access, IIS, HTML, CCS, JavaScript, Perl, XML and PHP
4-6 years of experience and proficiency with web development, security, maintenance and interfacing complex web reporting and web applications
Proven experience in coordinating complex projects, working with cross-functional teams, and delivering high-quality solutions.

Responsible for the design, development, and optimization of the Advancement CRM ecosystem and its integrations, ensuring stable system performance and reliable data movement across platforms. • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance the Advancement CRM (Advance*) and related enterprise applications supporting fundraising and alumni operations • Develop and maintain integrations between internal systems and third-party/vendor platforms, ensuring accurate and reliable data exchange • Manage data import processes from internal and external sources, including wealth screening and enrichment vendors • Define and implement data mapping, transformation, and validation rules for system integrations and imports • Design, code, and deploy custom .NET applications to automate data workflows and bridge gaps between CRM and external systems. • Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and automation scripts supporting operational and reporting needs • Perform Oracle database tuning, performance optimization, and maintenance activities • Support system upgrades, backups, recovery procedures, and lifecycle maintenance • Establish monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting processes to resolve integration and data flow issues • Perform root cause analysis and implement fixes for system synchronization or integration failures.

Responsible for ensuring trusted, accurate data and delivering reporting and analytics that support advancement strategy and decision-making. • Design and maintain enterprise reports and reporting frameworks for advancement operations • Lead report development lifecycle including requirements gathering, testing, validation, and documentation • Conduct routine and ad hoc data audits to identify inconsistencies, duplication, or quality issues • Develop dashboards and visualizations for leadership and operational stakeholders • Perform data analysis to identify trends and support fundraising and engagement strategies • Define and enforce data quality standards, business rules, and governance practices • Perform data cleansing, deduplication, and normalization to maintain a reliable dataset • Establish and enforce rigorous data integrity standards; develop automated scripts to identify and resolve duplicate records or formatting inconsistencies • Ensure alignment between reporting outputs and source systems for consistency and accuracy • Translate data into actionable insights for institutional decision-making • Promote effective use of analytics tools and data literacy across stakeholders.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Deep knowledge of database management, optimization, and reporting tools

Responsible for protecting sensitive data and ensuring proper access control, governance, and compliance across Advancement systems. • Manage user access, roles, and permissions within Advancement CRM systems • Implement and maintain data security controls to protect sensitive donor and alumni information • Ensure compliance with institutional policies, privacy regulations, and data governance standards • Conduct periodic access reviews and security audits • Collaborate with IT and campus security teams on cybersecurity and governance alignment • Monitor systems for unauthorized access or data misuse risks • Support investigation and resolution of data access issues or anomalies • Provide guidance on secure data handling and governance best practices • Maintain comprehensive documentation for custom code, database schemas, and standard operating procedures to ensure institutional knowledge retention
